scenario: [LUNI.8.9]: `distance.euclidean` takes `Float` coordinates ([LEXP.17.2]), so `meter` arguments are refused with DS_VALIDATE_DIM_MISMATCH. PATH PINNED: `dsc.typecheck.luni_8_9_dimensioned_arguments` on a `distance` member, which `dsc.builtin_fns.lexp_17_2_number_parameter` names.
rules_ds:
import distance

schema S scope logical:
    id: String key
    d: meter mutable

rule r:
    S s where distance.euclidean(s.d, s.d, s.d, s.d) > 1.0
->
    log info "x"
